Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s “If you have a Digimon in play with...2 or more colors in one of its digivolution cards” count a Digimon that has both a red card and a blue card in its digivolution cards?

Card Q&A.a:
No, it doesn't. Effects that grant additional colors don't do anything as digivolution cards, so the card is only treated as a single color.
